subject: Procurement acceptance workflow + spend-floor approval for renewal upsell
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@solsticehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@solsticehealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — procurement acceptance and spend-floor question

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — Solstice is planning to move from our current 6k monthly token commit to an initial 18k token commit for the next 12 months to support the new triage flows. Procurement asked me to confirm two things before we start the formal renewal:

1) Is there an internal “spend-floor” policy your finance/procurement team enforces for mid-contract capacity increases (we may need an exec sign-off if over a certain monthly spend)?
2) Can you share your vendor onboarding checklist and the PO routing matrix so I can forward them to our procurement team?

We want to avoid multiple back-and-forths between legal/procure and your team. If you want, loop in whoever owns procurement ops at Redwood and I can schedule a short sync.

Thanks — aim to finalize by end of May if possible.

Best,
Elena Torres
Director, Platform Ops
Solstice Health

Attachments: None (requested checklist + matrix)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — procurement acceptance and spend-floor question

Hi Elena —

Great to hear the triage flows are moving forward. Quick answers up front:

- Spend-floor: Redwood does have an escalation threshold at $25k/month for capacity increases that require Exec Approval. For committed monthly spend below that, standard SA/Enterprise procurement flow applies and can be handled by our Sales Ops / Finance reviewers.
- Onboarding & PO routing: I’ve attached our onboarding checklist and the PO approval matrix (see attachments). The matrix shows routing for purchase amounts and the typical approvers (Sales Ops -> Finance -> Legal escalation only for exceptions).

Action items for closing this quickly:
- Please confirm the expected monthly spend for the 18k commit so we can flag if it hits the $25k threshold.
- If your procurement team prefers a single consolidated packet, I can assemble: 1) onboarding checklist, 2) SOC 2 summary, 3) PO approval matrix, and 4) a draft SOW with the proposed term change.

I’ve looped in Ben Carter (Sales Ops) to confirm internal approvers and the estimated time for routing a PO once we receive a signed SOW.

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Onboard_Checklist_v2.pdf, PO_approval_matrix.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@solsticehealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — procurement acceptance and spend-floor question

Hi Elena, Hannah —

Thanks for the context. A few operational notes from Sales Ops so Solstice procurement can plan:

- If the 18k commit results in a monthly spend >= $25k, we will need an Exec approval ticket. That usually adds ~5 business days to routing; we can parallelize documentation prep to avoid added calendar time.
- Typical PO routing times (after SOW signed + PO submitted):
  * <$10k: 3–5 business days
  * $10k–$25k: 5–8 business days
  * >=$25k: 10–12 business days (includes exec review)

- Required items to attach to a PO submission: onboarding checklist, SOC 2 summary, Redwood vendor questionnaire answer set (I’ll attach a prefilled set if you want).

Next steps I propose:
1) Elena confirms expected monthly dollar amount for the 18k commit. If you’re unsure, provide a rough ARR delta and we’ll estimate.
2) Hannah will prepare the consolidated packet (SOW draft + checklist + matrix + SOC2).
3) Solstice sends the packet to procure@solsticehealth.com with a PO if ready — procurement should include a point-of-contact and preferred billing contact.

I’ve added the HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8421 (deal RD-8421).

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: Prefilled_Vendor_QA_Redwood.xlsx (will send on request)
From: procure@solsticehealth.com
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 May 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — procurement acceptance and spend-floor question

Hi Hannah and Ben —

Thanks for the details. A couple points from Solstice Procurement:

- Estimated monthly spend for the 18k commit is ~$22,600 — so this should fall under the standard approval lane (no exec ticket required).
- Please provide the consolidated packet Hannah mentioned (SOW draft + onboarding checklist + PO routing matrix + SOC2 summary) in one email to procure@solsticehealth.com. That will let us attach everything to the PO request and move to internal approvals.
- Preferred billing contact for the PO: procurement@solsticehealth.com (same mailbox). Please confirm billing address and Redwood tax ID in the packet.
- Expected internal timeline once we receive the packet + PO: 7–10 business days.

If you can bundle the items by EOD Friday (May 19), we’ll aim to have an approved PO back to you by May 31.

Procurement Team
Solstice Health
procure@solsticehealth.com

Attachments: None
